title: Store FAQ
content: The cotton tote can be spot-cleaned with mild soap and cold water. Do not use bleach or a tumble dryer. When a product fact is not listed in the catalog, ask the seller before making a claim.

title: Blue Linen Shirt product facts
content: The Blue Linen Shirt is listed in sizes S, M, L, and XL while stock remains available. The catalog fixture marks size M as available for the demo.

title: Standard shipping rules
content: Standard delivery to Ho Chi Minh City is normally estimated at 2–4 business days after dispatch. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed arrival time. Carrier status must be checked before making a delivery commitment.

title: Return and exchange policy
content: Exchange eligibility depends on the order, product, delivery date, item condition, and available stock. A seller must verify these details before confirming an exchange.

title: Payment discrepancy handling
content: Duplicate charges, refund requests, and unresolved payment status require seller or payment-operator review. Escala must not promise a refund or claim that a payment was reversed without verified transaction evidence.

title: Approved availability answer example
content: For a routine availability question, the seller may say: ‘Size M is currently listed as available. Standard delivery to Ho Chi Minh City is normally estimated at 2–4 business days after dispatch.’ Do not turn the estimate into a guarantee.

title: Seller-specific constraints
content: Escala cannot cancel orders, issue refunds, change delivery promises, apply exceptional discounts, or send a message externally without explicit seller approval. Public complaint threats and unresolved order-state requests go to the seller queue.
